Record Class SecurityPeriodSeries.Result

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.SecurityPeriodSeries.Result
Record Components:
holdingDays - calendar days after dateFrom up to dateTo held at the close
unitsStart - units as traded on dateFrom, null for a margin instrument
unitsEnd - units as traded on dateTo, null for a margin instrument
valueStartMC - value on dateFrom in main currency
valueEndMC - value on dateTo in main currency
inflowMC - sum of the inflows of the period in main currency
outflowMC - sum of the outflows of the period in main currency, as a positive amount
gainPeriod - gain of the period in security currency
gainPeriodMC - gain of the period in main currency
twr - time-weighted return in main currency as a ratio
twrSecurityCurrency - time-weighted return in security currency as a ratio
remark - cause of missing figures, null for a complete row
Enclosing class:
SecurityPeriodSeries
public static record SecurityPeriodSeries.Result(int holdingDays, Double unitsStart, Double unitsEnd, Double valueStartMC, Double valueEndMC, Double inflowMC, Double outflowMC, Double gainPeriod, Double gainPeriodMC, Double twr, Double twrSecurityCurrency, SecurityPeriodRemark remark) extends Record
Figures of one security. A figure that cannot be formed is null; remark() says why.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
